opening.argument: The demonstrated activity is ordinary wallet and exchange operation: the speaker explains, "So this is how to swap tokens on Uniswap," compares network fees, imports a token through MetaMask, and shows NFT purchasing on Uniswap. The fee comparison and token-configuration screen present practical operational steps, while the NFT workflow remains an ordinary platform use. Although the title uses misleading "HACK" and "free money" language, the supplied speech and frames show no bypass, guaranteed profit scheme, credential request, or deceptive participation flow. The evidence therefore supports an educational technology demonstration rather than a promise of effortless returns or an exploit-based outcome.
